findings.evidence: Skill text is retrieved untrusted context and must not gain authority.
findings.risk: Prompt injection could bypass tools or policy.
findings.fix: Loader detects authority-changing patterns, never executes scripts, and agents remain constrained by the registry and policies.

receipts.revisit: Skill content format or execution capability changes

findings.evidence: References could escape a skill directory or add executable files.
findings.risk: Untrusted repository files could enter prompts or execution.
findings.fix: Manifest paths are confined; only SKILL.md and references are allowed; hashes and frontmatter are verified.

corrections: Added path escape, hash mismatch and injection tests.

findings.evidence: Selection and loading are separate capabilities.
findings.risk: Combining them would couple policy to filesystem storage.
findings.fix: SkillRouter returns names/reasons; SkillLoader independently enforces integrity.

corrections: Kept one router and one loader source of truth.
receipts.revisit: Remote skills repository adapter is added

findings.evidence: Integrity, loading, receipt and cache logic share the same skill trust boundary.
findings.risk: Premature file splitting would add indirection without callers.
findings.fix: Kept focused types in one runtime module and routing in its established module.

receipts.revisit: Runtime module exceeds a coherent boundary

findings.evidence: Tests use real temporary manifest and files.
findings.risk: Mocking hash reads could hide integrity failures.
findings.fix: Behavior fixtures exercise real bytes, CRLF normalization, frontmatter and confinement.

findings.evidence: The loader does not fetch remote content itself.
findings.risk: Calling it a fetcher would overstate behavior.
findings.fix: Documentation describes loader verification and approved immutable inputs only.
